decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (McD/21092/EA/E1, McD/21092/EA/E2, McD/21092/EA/E3, McD/21092/EA/E4, McD/21092/EA/E5, McD/21092/EA/EP1, McD/21092/EA/EP2, McD/21092/EA/P2, McD/21092/EA/P5, McD/21092/EA/E2, Received 02/06/2011 and McD/21092/EA/P1, McD/21092/EA/P3, McD/21092/EA/P4, McD/21092/EA/EP2, Received 03/08/2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and part two storey, part single storey rear extension to the house including conversion of the garage into habitable space.
